test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.**

A. All I could hear was frogs croaking - and the rain.

B. But there was no sign of her, or any other passengers, or the plane.

C. I tried to look for my mother.

D. I found myself lying under a section of three seats turned upside down after the crash.
solution:
The correct answer is __DCBA__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• D can be our first part as it is the only part from which we got to know that there was a crash. hence it is the best choice for the first part.
 
• **C** further connects the sentence 'D', where the subject looks for his mother after the crash. Hence, 'A' is the second part.
 
• **B** has mentioned the pronoun '**her**' which refers to the subject's mother. Hence, 'B' and 'A' is the third and fourth part of the sentence respectively.

 

The correct sentence after rearranging the parts: __* I found myself lying under a section of three seats turned upside down after the crash. I tried to look for my mother, but there was no sign of her, any other passengers, or the plane. All I could hear was frogs croaking - and the rain.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **__Hint__***

__
 
• Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles:__

 
 
• Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence and eliminate the irrelevant options.
 
• Try to identify the opening( independent sentence) and closing sentences ( concluding sentence).
 
• Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants.
